description: Records that a CourtsApp card hit an error in its own code, so CourtsApp can fix the card. The CourtsApp cards call this on their own; it is not needed to answer a user and does not need to be called. It keeps which card, the kind of error, the error's message and where in the card it happened, and which assistant showed the card, and nothing about the person.

at.description: Where in the card's script it happened (line and column), when known.

kind.description: An error a script threw, or a promise nobody caught.

name: record_card_error

ok.description: True when the error was recorded.

title: Record Card Error
